name: plugloop-selfhost

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.seed:local: node scripts/seed.mjs > .seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file .seed.sql

description: Plugloop revenue-first analytics, self-hosted on Cloudflare Workers + D1

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Dashboard password. Leave empty to choose one on first visit (open the Worker right after deploying).

STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Optional. Stripe webhook **Signing secret** (`whsec_…`). You can add it later.

LEMONSQUEEZY_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Optional. Lemon Squeezy webhook signing secret.
